name: coding_execution_spine_v1
description: Primitive coding runtime state machine that normalizes context, mutation, validation, public-interface, blocker, and closure evidence into deterministic next actions.

primitive_first_contract.special_case_policy: Eval-specific filenames, expected symbols, framework names, and benchmark levels must stay in eval fixtures or evidence adapters. This primitive only consumes normalized evidence.
primitive_first_contract.monotonic_lower_level_regression_policy: Higher coding workflows may add evidence producers, validators, and repair policies, but must not change the state meanings or success/blocker transition rules of this spine.

state_transition_contract.context_rule: If context is required and no context evidence is sufficient for mutation, next action is build_context.
state_transition_contract.mutation_rule: If mutation is required and no successful mutation evidence exists, next action is mutate.
state_transition_contract.validation_rule: If validation is required and no successful validation evidence exists after latest mutation, next action is validate or repair depending on failed validation evidence.
state_transition_contract.public_interface_rule: If public interface verification is required and missing/failed, next action is repair.
state_transition_contract.closure_rule: If required context, mutation, validation, and public interface evidence are satisfied, next action is close_success.
state_transition_contract.blocker_rule: Any explicit blocker evidence closes blocked without another provider turn.
state_transition_contract.budget_rule: If repair turns exceed task contract budget, close failed_budget.

migration_policy.legacy_controller_rule: Existing coding runtime controllers must either emit normalized evidence into this spine or be quarantined as migration debt.
